statement: Recorded BEFORE any scored cell ran. The cell array had not been submitted and no cell file existed. Only the two validation gates had produced output, and neither imports rv8_analyse.py.
amends: RV8_FREEZE.json frozen_files_sha256.rv8_analyse.py, as already amended by addenda V1 and V2

defect_found_pre_execution.name: the mix-1.0 internal check asserted the wrong invariant
defect_found_pre_execution.evidence: addendum V1 added a check asserting that at mix 1.0 the 'balanced' and 'f1_only' cells hold IDENTICAL per-task units, on the reasoning that the non-F2 remainder is empty so both compositions yield the same stream. The family SEQUENCE is indeed identical, but composition is part of the per-task seed in stream_task(), so the two cells draw DIFFERENT tasks. The check as written would have reported false on every arm and been read as a determinism failure.
defect_found_pre_execution.attribution: analysis check stage: the invariant was derived from the family allocator alone and ignored the task seed.
defect_found_pre_execution.lever: replace it with the invariant that actually holds -- family sequences identical -- plus the genuinely informative one: the two cells are INDEPENDENT REPLICATES of the same distribution at mix 1.0, so their saving/task estimates must agree within their CIs. A disagreement there is a variance warning, not a determinism failure. Reported as mix1_replicate_check.
defect_found_pre_execution.side_benefit: at mix 1.0 the design therefore carries 10 independent stream draws per arm rather than 5

semantic_changes_to_frozen_endpoints: NONE. No arm, axis, cost term, stream, statistic or endpoint changes; this is an internal consistency check only.
note_on_this_being_caught_before_executi: This is the third defect found in the analysis before any scored cell existed. Each was found by checking a claim rather than assuming it, and each is recorded here rather than silently corrected.
